data.creator_notes:
Feeling cute AND quirky™️, so I updated her out of nowhere.
____

There's this neat HTML game, one that isn't a dogshit copy-paste mess using real porn (shocking, I know) called Course of Temptation. It's pretty good for a game still in development, kind of gives me Lilith's Throne vibes, which is another lewd game I also highly recommend.

Bella technically isn't an actual character from the game since most of the characters (if not, all of them I think?) are randomly generated, but I believe if you're playing a male, the character generated in the sexual harasser and bully role/archetype tends to be a female punk from my experiences playing the game, and just as this character's card implies, she has a habit of making you cream your pants through unwanted (or willing) outercourse, and will basically try to steal your homework, force you to do partnered projects solo, etc. They'll also harass other classmates, and spread rumours about you doing oral for money around the campus, at least from what I can tell in-game.

It is fun and nice to turn things around on the harasser when you actually beat the skill checks against them, but the submissive version of the harasser loses all of those good scenes, sadly. And worse yet, latest updates have toned down her harasser behaviours significantly, and forced some shitty 'she's actually an aspiring abstract art film director' subplot.

Naturally, the idea of some curvy punk bitch making me bust a nut with her fat ass tickles my pickle, so I just had to make her, and I figured she'd be a good bot to share.

Disclaimers as always: I don't know jack and shit about university or college because I'm a fucking NEET. While heavily inspired by Course of Temptation and even outright naming it, I don't pay attention to the lore so I made up a lot of shit.

New art generated on NAI 4.5.

Tested on Claude Sonnet 3, Claude Sonnet 3.5, Sonnet 3.7, Sonnet 4, and Novel AI. I find she's not so great on NAI without some rail roading though.
